description: This file defines the 'PimReportMenuConfigurator' class, which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface to configure menu items related to PIM reports in the OrangeHRM application. It utilizes traits for module screen helper functions and overrides the screen to 'viewDefinedPredefinedReports'.

classes.name: PimReportMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up PIM report menu items and behaviors.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'viewDefinedPredefinedReports' using the current module and screen context. Returns null after performing the override.
